subject: Impact snapshot from PoC — quick sync + short quote/permission
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@protoncloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Impact snapshot from PoC — quick sync + short quote/permission

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week PoC. We ran the end-to-end workload you provided against the production-ish dataset you shared and wanted to surface the topline impact and next asks. TL;DR — the changes we made delivered measurable latency and cost improvements while preserving accuracy on your eval set.

Key highlights (attached CSV has the full breakdown):
- Latency: p95 inference latency down 40% (from ~720ms -> ~430ms) across your 1k token median prompts.
- Throughput: sustained throughput increased ~3.2x under the same GPU profile thanks to continuous batching and KV-cache reuse.
- Cost per 1k tokens: estimated unit GPU cost reduced ~28% with quantization + batching policy.
- Quality: side-by-side eval shows <1.5% delta on your label set for top-1 accuracy; human spot-check looks good.

We have two favors to ask, both short:
1) Could ProtonCloud share a 1–2 line quote we can feature in a short case blurb? Example: "Redwood cut inference latency and cost for our search assist — enabling faster responses at half the run cost." Feel free to edit.
2) Can we schedule a 20-minute reference call (internal stakeholders + brief walk-through of the numbers) next week? We’ll keep it tight.

Attached: redwood-poc-impact-summary.csv (metrics export) and a one-page mutual-action-plan PDF that sketches a low-friction rollout path if you want to move forward.

If you prefer, Marissa (CC) can draft a 2-line quote and send for approval to save you time.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-poc-impact-summary.csv (text/csv)]
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@protoncloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@protoncloud.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Impact snapshot from PoC — quick sync + short quote/permission

Karthik —

Appreciate the concise summary and the attachments. The numbers look promising and align with what we observed during load testing. A couple quick notes:
- The latency improvements are meaningful for our user experience workstream.
- The cost estimates look plausible; we’ll validate with infra.

Short answers to your asks:
1) Quote: happy to provide a quick line. Draft below — feel free to tweak for brevity:
"Redwood’s serving optimizations significantly reduced latency and cost during our PoC, accelerating user flows while lowering infra spend."

2) Reference call: yes, we can do 20 minutes. I’m available Tue 7/20 10–11am PT or Wed 7/21 2–4pm PT. Tom (CC) will loop in procurement if we move to contract discussions.

Also, please mark the CSV as internal-only until we finalize wording; we’ll ask legal if a public case study is okay.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Morgan
Head of Product, ProtonCloud
[Sent from ProtonCloud on mobile]
